entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT GWALIOR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: For the reasons stated in the application, I.A.No.3371/2024 is allowed and the additional documents are taken on record.

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No.681 of 2022 registered at Police Station Dehat, District Bhind (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC.
First application of the applicant was dismissed by the Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 09.10.2023 in M.Cr.C.No.42352 of 2023.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is an innocent person and has been falsely implicated.

The F.I.R. was lodged on account of some dispute between the applicant as well as the complainant, however, now both the complainant and the applicant have settled their financial dispute and executed an agreement for payment of disputed amount.
The applicant is under custody since 23.08.2023.

After conclusion of investigation, charge sheet has already been filed, therefore,
his custodial interrogation is not required anymore.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Rewa (M.P.).
Conclusion of trial is likely to take time and there is no likelihood of his absconsion, if released on bail.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
P e r contra, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its dismissal.

Learned counsel for the complainant submitted that the matter has already been settled between the complainant and the applicant, therefore, the complainant has no objection if the bail is granted to the applicant.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
